meta.notes: FLUX 3 Image Klein, distilled checkpoint, BF16, via ComfyUI (>= 0.41.0). 16 steps, cfg 1. The prompt goes to the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder as the platform hands it over: BFL's prompt upsampler (a Qwen3.5 9B that rewrites every prompt before the image model sees it) is not in the workflow, although the model card says: "Do not use the model without a prompt upsampler." The config carries no optimization_instruction. The undistilled base checkpoint (flux3-image-klein-base-bf16, 50 steps, cfg 3.5; download_flux3.sh --base) has no config. gpu_vram_mb is the model card's figure: peak GPU memory with BFL's reference code, B200, 1024x1024, prompt upsampler off, 31 GB in BF16; the ComfyUI run here was not measured with nvidia-smi.
